name: Tiny Hello
summary: A new baby welcome page where wooden alphabet blocks drop under a turning crib mobile to spell the name
about: A soft nursery page to announce a new baby. A felt crib mobile with a sleepy moon, a smiling cloud and a hot air balloon drops in and turns, and wooden alphabet blocks tumble down, bounce and settle on a shelf to spell the name. Birth details sit in little cards, Wave hello makes the blocks jump and throws confetti, and the maker puts the name, details and colour in a link for the family group.
how: Open the page: the mobile drops in and turns while the blocks fall one by one onto the shelf.
Drag sideways across the mobile to spin it, and point at a piece to make it wiggle.
Tap a block to bounce it, or press Wave hello to make every block jump and send up confetti.
In Make one, type the name, parents, date, time, weight and length, and pick pink, blue or mint.
Press Copy link and send it; it opens with the blocks dropping in for the new name.
